title: Read the photo rules before you upload
body: Every form states the photo size and the KB limit. Find them in the notification first, then resize once, correctly.
caption:
Most rejected uploads come from skipping the instructions. Check the exact size, KB limit and file type in the notification before you start. 📋

Need it resized fast? Link in bio.

title: Plain background, face centered
body: Stand in front of a plain light wall. Keep your face in the middle, eyes open, no shadows behind you.
caption:
A clean, plain background avoids most photo rejections. Face the light, keep your head straight and look at the camera. 📸

Resize it to the exact form size with FormReady. Link in bio.

title: Sign on white paper with a dark pen
body: Use a black or dark blue pen on plain white paper. Take the photo straight on, then crop tightly around the signature.
caption:
A clear signature scan gets accepted the first time. Plain white paper, dark ink, no folds or shadows. ✍️

Resize your signature to the KB limit in seconds. Link in bio.

title: Start from the original photo
body: Don't shrink an already shrunk photo. Each re-save loses quality. Resize from the original every time.
caption:
Compressing the same file again and again makes it blurry. Keep your original and resize from it each time. 🖼️

Link in bio.

title: Keep one folder with all your documents
body: Photo, signature, ID proof, marksheets. Save them in one folder with clear names, ready for the next form.
caption:
Filling forms gets easy when your files are ready. One folder, clear file names, and you can apply in minutes. 📁

Link in bio.

title: Don't wait for the last day
body: Websites slow down or crash near the deadline. Apply a few days early, with everything ready.
caption:
Every deadline day, thousands of people get stuck on slow portals. Apply early and save yourself the stress. ⏰

Link in bio.

title: Spell your name exactly as on your ID
body: Your name, date of birth and father's name should match your certificates letter by letter.
caption:
A small spelling difference can cause problems later during document checks. Copy details exactly from your certificates. ✅

Link in bio.

title: Save your application number
body: After submitting, take a screenshot of the confirmation page and save the PDF. You will need it later.
caption:
Always keep proof of what you submitted. A screenshot of the confirmation page can save you a lot of trouble. 📲

Link in bio.

title: A fresher resume fits on one page
body: Put your name and contact at the top. Then education, skills, projects. Keep it to one clean page.
caption:
Recruiters scan a resume in seconds. One page, clear sections, easy to read. 📄

Make yours in minutes with FormReady. Link in bio.

title: Use simple fonts on your resume
body: Plain, readable fonts look professional. Fancy styles are hard to read and often look messy.
caption:
Clear beats fancy. A simple layout makes your skills easier to notice. ✨

Link in bio.

title: Add numbers to your resume
body: Say what you achieved, not only what you did. 'Handled 40 customers a day' beats 'Customer service'.
caption:
Numbers make your work easy to believe. Add counts, amounts or time wherever you can. 📈

Link in bio.

title: Keep your biodata short and clear
body: Name, age, education, work, family details and contact. A clear photo and tidy layout say more than long text.
caption:
A neat biodata makes a good first impression. Keep it simple, accurate and easy to read. 💍

Make one in minutes with FormReady. Link in bio.

title: Good light beats a good camera
body: Stand facing a window in daytime. Turn off the flash. Even a basic phone gives a clear photo.
caption:
Natural light is the easiest upgrade for any photo. Face a window and skip the flash. ☀️

Link in bio.

title: JPG is smaller than PNG
body: Most forms ask for JPG or JPEG. It keeps photos small, which helps you stay under the KB limit.
caption:
Photos need to be small, not just the right size. JPG is the usual choice for form uploads. 💡

Link in bio.

title: Write down your login details
body: Registration number, password, security answers. Save them somewhere safe. You will need them again.
caption:
Lost logins are one of the most common reasons people miss a step. Keep a safe note of your details. 🔐

Link in bio.

body: FormReady resizes photos on your device. Nothing is uploaded to a server.
caption:
Your photos and documents are personal. FormReady works right on your phone, so your files stay with you. 🔒
